notes: In Indian shops the changing room is the ट्रायल रूम (trial room).
पहनकर देखना ("wear and see") means to try clothes on. ट्राई करना is just as common.
Adjectives follow the item: कुर्ता छोटा है, but ड्रेस छोटी है (ड्रेस is feminine).
Sizes are said in English: स्मॉल, मीडियम, लार्ज.
